name: Amateur Chemist
source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

items.name: Light Mace
items.description: A light mace has a short wooden or metal shaft ending with a dense metal head. Used much like a club, it delivers heavy bludgeoning blows, but with extra power derived from the head's metal ridges or spikes.

items.name: Bottled Lightning (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate Strike

Bottled lightning is packed with volatile reagents that create a blast of electricity when they are exposed to air. Bottled lightning deals 2d6 electricity damage and 2 electricity splash damage. On a hit, the target becomes Off-Guard until the start of your next turn. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Frost Vial (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate Strike

The liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed cold damage and cold splash damage. On a hit, the target takes a status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, the bomb deals 2d6 cold damage and 2 cold splash damage, and the target takes a -10-foot penalty.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Alchemist's Tools
items.description: This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks.

items.name: Formula Book (Blank)
items.description: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.

items.name: Silvertongue Mutagen (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate Interact

Your features become striking and your voice becomes musical and commanding, though facts and figures become hazy for you and emotion clouds your ability to reason.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation and Performance checks. Your critical failures with any of these skills become failures instead.

Drawback You take a -2 item penalty to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks. Choose one skill in which you are trained; for the duration, you become untrained in that skill. All your failures to Recall Knowledge become critical failures.

Duration 10 minutes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Alchemical Formulas (5th)
offensiveAbilities.description: lesser antidote, moderate bottled lightning, moderate frost vial, graveroot, hunting spider venom, moderate quicksilver mutagen, moderate silvertongue mutagen

offensiveAbilities.name: Calculated Splash
offensiveAbilities.description: The chemist's bombs that have the splash trait deal 4 splash damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Alchemy
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents

Effect The chemist creates a single alchemical item from their formula book (see Alchemical Formulas). This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the start of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: The chemist Interacts to draw a bomb then Strikes with it.
